deadline.value: Fall 2027 application deadline is July 1 (Spring 2027 December 1; Summer 2027 April 1).

gre_general.value: All Ph.D. applicants must submit a valid GRE (or GMAT) score regardless of assistantship interest (minimum target 310/336 GRE or >80th percentile GMAT, though Doctoral Program Committee may grant individual waivers).
gre_general.quote: All applicants to the Ph.D. program are required to have a valid GRE/GMAT score, irrespective of whether they are applying for an assistantship or not.

also.quote: Applicants must score 310 out of 336 on the Graduate Record Exam (GRE) or above the 80th percentile on the Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT).
GRE requirement may be waived for students on an individual basis based on a review by the Doctoral Program Committee.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology (none in Biomedical Informatics).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: Program requires internet-based TOEFL 90 (above Graduate Council's 80 / 4.0 new-scale minimum).

ielts_min.value: Program requires IELTS 7.0 (above Graduate Council's 6.5 minimum).

supervisor.value: Applications are evaluated by the Doctoral Program Committee with attention to research alignment with IS&T faculty; no pre-application advisor confirmation is stated.

funding.value: Competitive UNO Graduate Assistantships (20 hrs/week, monthly salary, tuition remission up to 12 credits/semester, subsidized health insurance; limited to 6 semesters beyond a master's; selected individually by departments).
funding.quote: As a graduate assistant you will be considered a UNO employee with a tuition waiver, monthly salary, and subsidized health insurance. | doctoral students are limited to six (6) semesters beyond their master's degree.

also.quote: GAs are selected by each department individually, so please contact your department's office to apply.

entry_route.value: Requires a baccalaureate degree (3.5+ GPA recommended) with preference given to applicants holding a related master's or doctoral degree; 90 credits beyond the bachelor's with up to 24 prior graduate credits transferable.
entry_route.quote: successfully completed a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution: preference will be given to students with a master's or doctoral degree from a related field. | A maximum of 24 credit hours of graduate coursework can be transferred from courses taken in a graduate program prior to admission into the PhD in BMI.

notes: Joint doctoral program offered by UNO and the University of Nebraska Medical Center (UNMC). Requires 3 letters of recommendation, CV, 2-page statement of purpose, and a writing sample/research portfolio; admission statement notes PTE 61 vs Catalog PTE 64 (Catalog used).
name: Biomedical Informatics, Ph.D.
